# Getting started {#getting-started}

These short activities show how AI assistants can help with common tasks: summarizing documents, checking forms, drafting emails, processing notes and planning activities. We are using **UU AI-Chat** as the university's approved platform.

1. Open **[UU AI-Chat](https://aichat.uu.nl/)** and sign in with your UU account.
2. Choose any exercise relevant to your work. The instructions are meant as guidance, so feel free to adapt the exercises to your needs and interests.
3. Open or download the linked materials and share them with UU AI-Chat by **pasting the text** or **uploading the files**. You can use the suggested prompt as a starting point and adapt it to your needs.

[Link to slides](slides/UU_AI_Chat_Admin_Intro.pptx)

All exercise materials below are **AI-generated examples**, not official Utrecht University documents.

For this workshop, use the fictional examples or approved non-sensitive material. Do not upload confidential or sensitive work information unless the applicable UU rules allow it.

AI assistants can make mistakes. Instructions such as "do not guess" can help, but do not guarantee accuracy. Check important information against the original documents.

Compare procedures](#exercise-5-compare-two-versions-of-a-procedure) · [6. Create an FAQ](#exercise-6-turn-a-procedure-into-an-faq) |
| Communicate | [3. Write an email](#exercise-3-draft-or-improve-an-email) · [7. Translate a message](#exercise-7-translate-and-simplify-a-message) |
| Organise work | [4. Process meeting notes](#exercise-4-process-meeting-notes) · [8. Plan an event](#exercise-8-plan-a-departmental-event) · [9. Check a spreadsheet](#exercise-9-check-a-simple-spreadsheet) |
| Personalise | [10. Try your own task](#exercise-10-bring-your-own-task) |
| Make it reusable | [11. Saved Prompt](#exercise-11-save-a-prompt-for-repeated-emails) · [12. Persona](#exercise-12-build-a-reusable-form-reviewer-persona) · [13. Project](#exercise-13-use-a-project-across-separate-chats) |

If you are new to AI assistants, Exercises 3, 4 and 7 are good starting points.

::: {.callout-tip appearance="minimal"}
**UU AI-Chat features at a glance**

**Chat** handles a one-off task; **saved Prompts** reuse instructions; **Personas** reuse an assistant's working method or reference material; **Projects** keep related chats and files together. These features assist work—they do not automatically send emails, approve forms or change university systems.
:::

# Going further with AI
While we have focused on the basics here, AI assistants can help with more, such as creating websites, applications, or tools to automate repeated tasks. Some of these activities require additional tools or steps beyond a regular chat. Are there any other possibilities you'd like to explore?
